Classic hits from just 1 year - 1970!
From the era of glam rock, new wave and disco, it's all the hits from just one decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready?
You won't believe these 70 hits never even reached the top 2 in the UK! Includes songs from Abba & Michael Jackson, plus forgotten tracks from Fox, Faron Young & Fiddler's Dram.

Blimey, what a year! Get ready to turn your telly up LOUD, with the greatest party anthems from '78 including Grease, Saturday Night Fever, Blondie, Ian Dury, Dan Hartman and Chic.
60 minutes of hits and headlines from the year Larry Grayson first shouted "Shut that door!" on The Generation Game, and Ted Rogers rolled out his robotic dustbin on 3-2-1.
